summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce the removal of Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer for the MY Portfolio Mortgage Loan (1.0% of the pool) and the appointment of Midland Loan Services as successor special servicer under the CSMC 2016-NXSR PSA. This is a routine servicing transfer for a CMBS trust, not a special situation. No price, premium, board recommendation, or structural changes are involved. The filing is purely administrative; there is no event with risk-arb implications.
